## Summary

Osama Mumtaz is a Technical Product Manager and Senior Software Engineer with
more than seven years in mobile development, based in Islamabad, Pakistan. He
works at the intersection of product and engineering — leading teams, shaping
roadmaps, and still writing code. At Funsol Technologies he leads Android, QA,
design and AI teams. He has shipped more than 50 apps to the Google Play Store,
led more than 40 engineers, and managed more than 5 teams.

Core specialisms: Android development in Kotlin and Java, Jetpack Compose,
Compose Multiplatform, Firebase, technical product management, engineering
team leadership, Play Store growth, and AdMob monetisation within Google
policy. He also builds and ships web tools.

## Skills and technologies

Kotlin, Java, Python, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Jetpack Compose,
Compose Multiplatform, Android SDK, Android Studio, Django, Firebase,
PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Docker, Git, Figma, MVVM, Clean Architecture,
SOLID principles, RESTful APIs, AdMob, AI feature integration.

## Services offered

Osama takes on Android and cross-platform app development, technical product
management for mobile products, engineering team leadership and mentoring,
Play Store launch and monetisation strategy, AI feature integration, and
backend or DevOps support for mobile products.

## Projects

### CapDownloader - CapCut Video Downloader (Web)
https://capdownloader.com/
A free web tool for saving CapCut videos without the watermark. Paste a CapCut
URL and get a clean HD file back as MP4 or MP3, with no software to install and
no account. Processing is instant, downloads are unlimited and nothing is
retained server-side. The site also serves as a reference on CapCut itself, with
a "What is CapCut?" explainer covering editing, templates, effects, captions and
audio, plus an FAQ, a privacy page, multi-language support and light and dark
themes.

### Noor e Hunar - Custom Couture Brand Site (Web)
https://noorehunar.vercel.app/
A brand site for a made-to-order Pakistani couture label. Luxury formals and
pret are recreated by hand and stitched to the customer's measurements at a
fraction of the designer price; the customer sends a photo and the studio
handles everything from sketch to doorstep. The site leads with a portfolio of
real client pieces from Instagram, explains the ordering process, and backs it
with a wall of genuine DM and WhatsApp messages rather than typed-up quotes.
Orders run through Instagram DM, with a free sketch and quote as the entry
point.

### Turbo Shield VPN - Fast & Secure VPN (Android)
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.turboshieldvpn.fastsecure.vpn
An Android VPN client built around leak protection and transparency rather than
a single connect button. Smart Connect picks the fastest server automatically,
while the full server list shows real-time load and latency per location and can
be filtered for OTT streaming, gaming or standard use. Settings expose a kill
switch that holds the tunnel open while reconnecting, IPv6 blocking so traffic
cannot route around an IPv4-only tunnel, privacy-focused Cloudflare DNS,
Android-level always-on VPN, split tunnelling and connect-on-launch. A live
stats screen graphs throughput, latency, VPN IP and protocol, and every session
ends with a recap of time connected, bandwidth used and whether any leaks
occurred. Technologies: Android, VPN, OpenVPN, privacy.

### ReelstoMP4 - Facebook Reels & Video Downloader (Web)
https://reelstomp4.com/
A free web tool that turns a Facebook link into an MP4 — paste the URL of a
public reel or video and save it in HD straight to a phone or PC, with no app
to install, no signup and no data stored. Works with both facebook.com and
fb.watch links, places no cap on downloads, and ships light and dark themes
plus multi-language support alongside Features, How-to and FAQ pages.

### GeoPromptTracker - GEO Toolkit for AI Search (Web)
https://geoprompttracker.com/
A free toolkit for Generative Engine Optimization — making sure ChatGPT,
Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews can find, read and cite your site.
It bundles 19 no-sign-up tools, including an llms.txt generator, a FAQPage
JSON-LD schema generator, and an AI-Readiness Audit that scores any URL against
the technical signals that matter for AI visibility, in the spirit of a
Lighthouse report but scoped to GEO/AEO. Alongside the tools sits a maintained
directory of 28 AI crawlers explaining what each bot does, whether it actually
respects robots.txt, and the copy-paste rules to allow or block it, plus 38
long-form guides.

### sssxdown - X (Twitter) Video Downloader (Web)
https://sssxdown.com/
A free web tool for saving public videos and GIFs from X (formerly Twitter) —
paste a post link and download in a couple of clicks, with no login, no
watermark and nothing stored server-side. It handles several links at once,
ships a light and dark theme, and is localised into multiple languages.
Supporting pages cover how-to steps, an FAQ, release notes and a privacy policy.

### SnapLingo - AI-Powered Language Learning App (Mobile)
An intelligent, cross-platform language learning application developed in
Compose Multiplatform, designed specifically for children. It delivers a highly
personalised educational experience through dynamic AI-generated lessons and an
interactive AI chat tutor. Gamification features include XP points, daily
streaks and achievement badges. A family management system lets parents track
multiple children's progress, alongside a subscription model for premium
content. Technologies: Kotlin, Compose Multiplatform, Jetpack Compose, AI.

### Live Wallpapers 4K, HD, Anime - AI-Powered Personalization App (Android)
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wallpaperapp.hdwallpapers.livewallpaperfree.coolwallpapers
A feature-rich, dynamic screen personalisation application. It goes beyond
static backgrounds with an integrated AI Wallpaper Generator, letting users
create custom high-definition wallpapers from text prompts, and houses a
categorised library of ultra-HD 4K, 3D and 4D parallax wallpapers.
Technologies: Kotlin, AI.

### PDF Scanner: Document Reader (Android)
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.docscan.camscan.pdfscanner.pagescanner.documentscanner
A comprehensive utility application that turns a smartphone camera into a
portable document scanner. Users can scan, manage and share high-quality PDFs
on the go. It uses advanced image processing to capture multi-page documents,
ID cards and books. Technologies: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Camera API.
